:::{#exr-linear-operator-practice}
#### Testing whether a projection is a linear operator

Dropping the last coordinate of a point in $\reals^3$ projects it onto a plane,
as a shadow does.
Let $f: \reals^3 \to \reals^2$ be $f(\vx) = (x_1, x_2)$.
This $f$ is a [linear map](#def-linear-map).

Is $f$ a [linear operator](#def-linear-operator) on $\reals^3$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Write $f$ as $f: \reals^p \to \reals^m$,
and compare $p$ with $m$ as in @def-linear-operator.

:::

:::
